detailedServices.title: Residential Interior
detailedServices.subtitle: Your Home, Elevated
detailedServices.description: We transform apartments, flats, and villas into bespoke living spaces that reflect your personality and lifestyle. Every element is considered, every corner crafted.

faqs.q: How long does a residential interior project take?
faqs.a: Timeline depends on scope. A single room takes 3–4 weeks; a full apartment typically takes 8–12 weeks from design approval to final handover.

faqs.q: Do you work across Delhi NCR and other cities?
faqs.a: Yes, we are headquartered in New Delhi and actively execute turnkey projects across Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Faridabad, and Pan-India locations.

faqs.q: Can I choose my own materials?
faqs.a: Absolutely. We guide you through curated material options and also accommodate client-supplied materials and custom finishes.

detailedServices.title: Commercial Interior
detailedServices.subtitle: Spaces That Work
detailedServices.description: We design commercial spaces that balance brand identity, employee productivity, and client impression — offices, showrooms, restaurants, cafés, hotels.

faqs.q: Can you handle large commercial projects?
faqs.a: Yes. We have executed projects from small offices to large hotel fit-outs. Our team scales to the project size.

faqs.q: Do you offer 3D visualization before execution?
faqs.a: Yes — all projects include detailed 3D renders for client approval before any execution begins.

detailedServices.title: Turnkey Projects
detailedServices.subtitle: One Point of Responsibility
detailedServices.description: From the first brick to the final furnishing — we manage everything, so you don't have to coordinate with multiple vendors. One contract, one team, zero hassle.

faqs.a: Turnkey means we handle everything — design, civil, electrical, false ceiling, modular cabinetry, flooring, and wall finishes — delivering a fully move-in-ready space.

faqs.q: Is turnkey more expensive than managing separately?
faqs.a: Our bulk procurement and process efficiency often make turnkey cost-comparable or cheaper than managing vendors individually.

detailedServices.title: Design & 3D Visualisation
detailedServices.subtitle: Concept to Completion
detailedServices.description: A full-service design journey: concept development, 3D visualization, material selection, precision execution, and quality finishing — under one roof.

faqs.q: How many 3D revision rounds are included?
faqs.a: Our standard package includes 3 revision rounds. Additional rounds are available at a nominal charge.
Yes, we offer standalone design & 3D visualization packages if you have your own execution team.

projects.title: Rawls Salon — Flagship Turnkey Luxury Salon
projects.description: Complete turnkey facade engineering, MEP infrastructure, and opulent European interior execution for Rawls Salon. Features custom gold-leaf arched styling mirrors, geometric marble flooring, illuminated 3D crest branding, and artisanal carpet reception counter.
projects.challenge: Executing multi-level structural facade modifications alongside bespoke joinery, acoustic privacy treatment suites, and high-efficiency central ventilation on schedule.
projects.solution: Precision steel facade scaffolding reinforcement, handcrafted gold-leaf styling arches, Italian marble flooring, and customized retail vitrines.
projects.clientQuote: The craftsmanship from the facade structure to the interior mirrors and reception desk is top-tier.

projects.title: Gurugram Corporate Office — Modern Turnkey Workspace
projects.description: Turnkey commercial workspace fitout and architectural interior execution for a flagship corporate office in Gurugram. Features an expansive open workstation floor with suspended acoustic dome pendants, geometric suspended LED profile lights, frameless glass executive director cabins, 12-seater boardroom, and modular heavy-gauge desk clusters with integrated raceways.
projects.challenge: Transforming a bare-shell corporate floorplate into a high-performance workspace with acoustic isolation between cabins and workstation bays, comprehensive MEP and server cabling, within a fast-tracked 10-week schedule.
projects.solution: Constructed sound-dampened acoustic glass partitions, suspended square LED profile luminaires from an exposed dark industrial slab, engineered dual-sided cable trays with modular floor junction boxes, and delivered custom oak veneer executive cabin joinery.
projects.clientQuote: Bright Space Interiors delivered our Gurugram corporate headquarters with flawless precision. The workstations, lighting design, and boardroom execution exceed our international corporate standards.

projects.title: Shri Ram Complex — Civil, Interior & Waterproofing
projects.location: Shri Ram Complex, Sushant Lok Phase 1, Gurugram
projects.description: Comprehensive civil and commercial interior execution including specialized industrial waterproofing in V-Deliver kitchen at Shri Ram Complex, Sushant Lok Phase 1, Gurugram. Covering 2,500 sq ft of carpet area, this site started in the first week of December 2020 and was successfully finished on 20 February 2021. Scope included precision on-site stone cutting, diamond-border marble flooring, multi-tier gypsum cove ceiling illumination, commercial waterproofing membranes, and architectural timber panelling.
projects.challenge: Executing rigorous multi-layer commercial waterproofing for the high-capacity V-Deliver kitchen, structural slab core drilling, and simultaneous ornate interior carpentry within an active commercial complex on a tight 11-week deadline.
projects.solution: Applied specialized commercial-grade waterproofing membranes across the culinary floorplate, deployed laser-guided on-site granite & stone fabrication, crafted classical gypsum mouldings with warm cove LEDs, and engineered custom architectural timber joinery with strict quality milestones.
projects.clientQuote: Bright Space executed the civil, interior, and waterproofing work for our 2,500 sq ft facility at Shri Ram Complex with flawless project management, completing on 20 February 2021 right on schedule.
materials: Gypsum Cove False Ceiling & LED Profiles

projects.title: Bespoke Modular Kitchens — Delhi NCR
projects.location: Amar Colony, Old Rajendra Nagar, Saket, Faridabad, Gurugram, Noida (Delhi NCR)
projects.description: Turnkey modular kitchen design and execution across prime locations in Delhi NCR including Amar Colony, Old Rajendra Nagar, Saket, Faridabad, Gurugram, and Noida. Our portfolio highlights high-gloss acrylic & PU shutters, Marquina black marble backsplashes, seamless under-cabinet profile lighting, undermount sinks, Blum soft-close hydraulic hardware, and custom-crafted wooden breakfast counter partitions.
projects.challenge: Executing precision modular kitchen layouts across varying apartment footprints in Delhi NCR with zero tolerances, water-resistant marine grade carcasses, and fast on-site commissioning.
projects.solution: Utilized precision laser measurements, BWP boiling waterproof plywood, premium acrylic surfaces, integrated LED profile illumination, and meticulous on-site hardware fitting by master craftsmen.
projects.clientQuote: The Bright Space Interiors transformed our kitchen into an ergonomic, modern culinary space. Their cabinetry finish, stone backsplash, and lighting details are immaculate.

projects.title: Mr. Manish Singh's Home — Civil & Interior Work
projects.description: Comprehensive civil and interior work for Mr. Manish Singh in Park View City, Sector 48, Gurugram. Our turnkey execution included vitrified floor tiling, wooden paint and polish work, bronze grid tinted mirror wall panelling, fluted feature walls with floating console, and architectural glass partitions.
projects.challenge: Executing high-precision floor tiling, flawless wooden paint & polish finishes, and seamlessly integrating geometric mirror panelling across a 1,300 sq ft carpet area.
projects.solution: Engineered an open-concept luxury layout: laser-levelled vitrified marble-finish floor tiles, bronze grid accent mirror panelling to expand spatial depth, fluted accent walls with floating vanity joinery, and durable artisanal wood paint and polish finishes.
projects.clientQuote: Bright Space executed the floor tiles, wooden paint, and polish work with outstanding craftsmanship. The flat feels expansive, modern, and completely transformed.

projects.title: The Hair Palace London — Salon & Academy
projects.description: Turnkey architectural facade design and luxury interior execution for The Hair Palace London. Features a grand two-story glass facade, celebratory floral entrance archways, illuminated brand signage, and multi-tier salon academy stations.
projects.challenge: Transforming an expansive commercial space into a distinguished European-style luxury academy while ensuring flawless MEP and sound isolation between academy and salon floors.
projects.solution: Engineered structural facade reinforcement, custom architectural signage, high-efficiency central air handling, and zone-specific dimmable lighting throughout.
projects.clientQuote: Bright Space Interiors delivered our flagship luxury salon and academy with international standards. The finished execution is stunning.

projects.title: L'Oréal & Kérastase Retail Lounge
projects.description: Luxury retail and client reception lounge featuring custom L'Oréal Professionnel Paris and Kérastase Paris branded display shelving, back-lit translucent marble reception desk, statement yellow velvet armchairs, and acoustic ceiling.
projects.challenge: Balancing high-density retail merchandise display with welcoming, uncluttered five-star hospitality aesthetics.
projects.solution: Concealed LED strip illumination behind frosted glass shelves, custom marble counter with inset halo lighting, and rich oak acoustic wall cladding.
projects.clientQuote: Product sales and client dwell time doubled immediately. The lighting and marble craftsmanship are world-class.

projects.title: Executive Waiting Suite & Pedispa
projects.description: Distinguished client waiting lounge and dedicated pedicure wellness zone featuring a deep-buttoned burgundy leather Chesterfield sofa, Persian rug, classical gold-leaf mirror, and custom brick-and-timber pedicure stations.
projects.challenge: Harmonizing heritage warmth with modern clinical hygiene for premium spa treatments.
projects.solution: Exposed rustic brickwork, sealed solid timber planking, individual plumbed hydrotherapy foot basins, and custom leather seating.
projects.clientQuote: Our clients love taking photos in this lounge. It feels like an exclusive private club.

projects.title: Royal Styling Stations & Private Treatment Suites
projects.description: Opulent commercial styling suite featuring arched gold-leaf full-height mirrors, vintage hydraulic styling chairs, checkerboard marble flooring, and private artisanal pine treatment suites with O3+ branding.
projects.challenge: Accommodating individual client privacy while maintaining a cohesive, open royal luxury atmosphere.
projects.solution: Constructed custom acoustic private treatment rooms with artisanal pine barn-doors, alongside open-format gilded mirror stations and check-patterned flooring.
projects.clientQuote: The styling mirrors and timber doors are an instant favorite with our clientele. It creates an unforgettable brand experience.

projects.title: Saket Dual-Tone Modular Kitchen
projects.description: Modern turnkey modular kitchen delivered with dual-tone anthracite and ivory acrylic cabinets, seamless quartz countertop, marble splashback, high-efficiency chimney, and architectural timber partition screen.
projects.challenge: Creating maximum storage and prep counter surface in an open-concept flat while providing visual privacy from the living foyer.
projects.solution: Full-height vertical cabinetry with soft-close Blum hardware, seamless quartz counter with integrated under-mount sink, and vertical wood baffle divider.
projects.clientQuote: From 3D design to site handover, Bright Space managed every detail cleanly. The kitchen finish is immaculate.

projects.title: Contemporary Cherry & Cream Turnkey Kitchen
projects.description: Ergonomic L-shaped turnkey modular kitchen executed with high-gloss cream overhead cabinets, rich cherry-wine base drawers, concealed under-cabinet profile lighting, and undermount double-bowl sink.
projects.challenge: Fitting high-capacity storage, heavy appliance wiring, and water filtration equipment seamlessly without compromising visual symmetry.
projects.solution: Custom cabinetry with soft-close tandem boxes, hidden LED track lighting beneath upper units, and durable high-temperature acrylic finishes.
projects.clientQuote: The finish on the cabinets and the under-cabinet lighting makes cooking a pleasure. On-time handover with zero hassle.

projects.title: Agarwal Family Turnkey Residence
projects.description: Turnkey home interior blending classical warmth with modern European minimalism for an expansive family flat.
projects.challenge: Remote project management and procurement with strict timeline constraints.
projects.solution: End-to-end off-site fabrication, scheduled site installations, and daily supervisory video updates.
projects.clientQuote: Managing our home from start to finish with such professionalism was truly remarkable.
